about: What a fresh Tiger install is offered out of the gate. Read LIVE by installer front-ends (TigerWHM today); edit this file on main and every new install sees it — no host updates anything. Themes and modules themselves come from the Directory (WebTigers/TigerVendors data/index.json); this file decides what is featured and defines the skill packs. The `intro` block is the copy the installer page shows above/below the site list (hero + discovery cards).

hero.title: Build a website by talking to AI.
hero.text: Tiger is an AI-native website and application platform. Tell your AI what you want — a business site, a store, a membership site, a blog, a custom app — and build it without learning themes, plugins or page builders.

cards.title: Just describe it.
cards.text: Tell your AI about your business and it builds the pages, navigation, content and forms you need.

cards.title: The business pieces are already here.
cards.text: Payments, stores, memberships, downloads and subscriptions come as Tiger modules.

cards.title: Go beyond websites.
cards.text: Tiger is a structured, extensible application platform. Your AI builds custom workflows without starting from scratch — and the site you start with never has to be replaced.

skill_packs.name: Web design
skill_packs.description: Design-led front-end work: layouts, brand systems, themes and polished UI — the skills a designer building a site with Tiger's agent reaches for first.

skill_packs.name: Content & publishing
skill_packs.description: Writing and authoring on Tiger: pages, articles, documents and co-authored drafts with the agent.

skill_packs.name: Development
skill_packs.description: Build on Tiger the update-safe way: modules, /api web services, admin screens, tests — and MCP/Claude API know-how for AI features.

skill_packs.name: Documents & files
skill_packs.description: Read and produce Word, Excel, PowerPoint and PDF files from inside Tiger's agent.
